verses.text: By the fig and the olive[1]
We have certainly created man in the best of stature;[2]
Then We return him to the lowest of the low,[3]
Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?[4]
Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

footnotes.1: Referring to the places known for their production, i.e., Damascus and Jerusalem, respectively. It could also refer to the fig and olive trees or to the fruits themselves.
footnotes.2: i.e., upright, symmetrical, and balanced in form and nature.
footnotes.3: This can refer to the depths of Hell, to decrepit old age or to immorality.
footnotes.4: More literally, "What makes you lie concerning it?"
